test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one - word substitute for the given group of words.

To criticise someone severely
solution: The correct answer is Option 3. i.e. **"Chastise"**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Chastise**: Rebuke or reprimand severely or **to criticise someone severely**. (डांटना: कठोर रूप से फटकार या समालोचना करना।) • **Example**: The teacher **chastised** the student for repeatedly coming late to class. Therefore, the correct answer is "Chastise". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Rate**: A measure, quantity, or frequency. (दर: एक माप, मात्रा, या फ़्रीक्वेंस) • **Remonstrate**: Make a forcefully reproachful protest. (विरोध जताना: एक शक्तिशाली तरीके से निंदा का प्रदर्शन करना।) • **Scoff**: Speak to someone or about something in a scornfully derisive or mocking way. (ठट्ठा करना: किसी से या किसी चीज़ के बारे में उपेक्षापूर्ण तरीके से या हंसी उड़ाते हुए बात करना।) • **Example**: They scoffed at the idea that the project could be completed in a week. 20b:Tf9b, The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. **"Euphoria"**.
